# TradingView Lightweight Charts™

The chart library the wallet draws its market chart with (as SeqDEX does): version 5.2.1,
the standalone ES module build (`lightweight-charts.standalone.production.mjs`),
unmodified, from the npm package `lightweight-charts@5.2.1` (tarball sha1
`5a27ead719573607d4d3483ad2728c055ccea8fd`).

Licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`). `NOTICE` is the library's
attribution notice: a page that shows a chart shows it, with a link to
https://www.tradingview.com/ (`CHART_NOTICE` in `chart.js`), and every
chart keeps the library's attribution logo.

Source: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts
